status: Both full-source transfer gates FAIL. Normalization improves some matched models but does not establish consistent cross-room pose or motion recovery.
scope: SOURCE DEVELOPMENT only, seed2027. E01-E03/all30people/27actions/810records, no E04 or target calibration. Repeated source development is not an untouched final efficacy test. Provided normalized 2D reference labels, no independent 3D validation.
timing: Authors describe roughly100Hz firmware CSI grouped as ten columns per100ms, then synchronized at10Hz. Individual packet timestamps/order not independently verified. Continuity is a heuristic, not proof of clock/order. Signed bands are nominal frequencies, not calibrated physical velocities/BVP/AoA.

protocol.selection: All fold/arm/target choices frozen before held scoring. Source validation NJE for currentpose; raw MSE for each displacement head. Natural linear/RFF chosen independently pertarget by source validation.
protocol.mask: Same conservative40frame covariance validity mask and extra shared all-three-spectral-variant mask. Spectral input itself uses8groupedframes. Baseline covariance models retain their longer context/original training mask; only hip-relative heads compared on exact common held rows.
protocol.displacement_score: Raw R²=1-SSE/sum(true_displacement²); zero predictor scores0. No record-mean repair, GT previouspose input or query statistics. Component heads select regularization independently; their outputs are not an exact decomposition.
protocol.shape: Each [2links,19subcarrierbins,10signedbands] vector normalizes its last10bands via x-(10/ln10)logsumexp(x*ln10/10). No cross-example statistics. Cancels common additive cached-band dB shifts; physical interpretation requires band/subcarrier-common window-constant gain. Pre-log floors/clipping, subcarrier-dependent multipath and time-varying gain limit this premise. Total dynamic power is discarded.

local_positive_control.scope: Fixed E01/S01/A12, purged disjoint time blocks within one recording, not person/room generalization. Pose111/45/104; displacement110/44/103. Raw and quotient displacement controls freshly paired; historical pose references have their own earlier protocol.

public_reproduction_benchmark.scope: Post-fit compute-only timing on fixed E01/S01/A12 window ending39; E01 natural RFF512 and all four heads. Includes quotients, FFT380, normalization if shape, map and prediction. Excludes I/O, acquisition, UI, synchronization and conservative mask handling. No pose labels or selection.
public_reproduction_benchmark.thread_settings: Set OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 before starting Python to reproduce single-thread settings. Actual timing depends on host load.
public_reproduction_benchmark.units: Milliseconds of computation per window. Input nominally 8 grouped 10 Hz frames; exact subpacket timestamps not independently verified. This is not end-to-end application FPS.

earlier_task_local_benchmark.scope: Post-fit benchmark only, no model selection. E01 natural RFF512, all four readouts, real fixed E01/S01/A12 window ending39. Includes complex quotients, FFT380, pointwise normalization, map and prediction. Excludes disk I/O, acquisition, UI, synchronization and conservative validity-mask processing. Native CPU with single-thread environment; no GPU. Nominal input context8x10 grouped samples, not measured packet timing.

runtime.limit: Two observed runs vary with host load; compute-only timing cannot establish application FPS or prediction efficacy. Source snapshots preserved; benchmark changes no selection.
